summary: The story is mechanism-first and grounded in the actual pi-model-orchestrator files. It correctly separates execution mode from complexity and does not treat worker identity as model identity.

findings.detail: src/spawn-worker.ts currently casts the Pi runtime context. Replace this with the concrete Pi ExtensionContext type when the integration surface is finalized.
policy.md describes local -> medium -> high escalation, but executable retry/escalation logic is not yet present in src/.
policy.md defines the telemetry contract, but the current TypeScript helper does not emit those measurements yet.
DeepSeek V4 Flash Latest and Claude Sonnet Latest are intentionally moving aliases. Revalidate behavior and thinking-level compatibility periodically.
qwen2.5-coder:7b and local concurrency=1 are conservative starting assumptions, not measured optima. Run benchmarks before tuning.
